name: codebook-md
description: Run the code blocks in your markdown files. Open any README or runbook as a notebook and execute Go, Shell, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL and HTTP - locally, with output inline. Also browse and health-check your AI agent docs: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills and rules.

codebook-md.rootPath.description: The root path of the workspace. This is used to resolve relative paths in code blocks.

codebook-md.notebookConfigPath.description: Directory path where notebook configuration files will be stored. Configuration files are named with the notebook filename + '.config.json'. If not set, defaults to the same value as execPath.

codebook-md.execPath.description: Path where temporary exec-related file(s) will be stored.

codebook-md.permalinkPrefix.description: Prefix for identifying permalinks. When matched in a markdown, the permalink will be converted to a link to the same file/lines in VS Code.

codebook-md.frontMatter.showInNotebook.description: Show YAML Front Matter as the first cell in notebooks

codebook-md.go.execType.description: Execution type for Go code: 'run' uses execTypeRunConfig, 'test' uses execTypeTestConfig.

filename.description: Filename to use for 'run' execution type.
Filename to use for 'test' execution type.

buildTag.description: Build tag to use for 'test' execution type. This tag is added to the top of the test file to help ensure it doesn't run in normal test runs.

codebook-md.go.goimportsCmd.description: 'goimports' requires goimports to be installed. If null, 'gopls imports' will be used.

codebook-md.go.excludeOutputPrefixes.description: Output lines starting with any of these prefixes are hidden from Go cell output.

codebook-md.go.output.showExecutableCode.description: go: Show the executable code at the top of the output. Overrides codebook-md.output.showExecutableCodeInOutput.

codebook-md.go.output.replaceOutputCell.description: go: Replace the output cell on each run. When false, output is appended. Overrides codebook-md.output.replaceOutputCell.

codebook-md.go.output.showTimestamp.description: go: Show the timestamp at the top of the output. Overrides codebook-md.output.showTimestamp.

codebook-md.go.output.timestampTimezone.description: go: Timezone to use for the timestamp (e.g. 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Overrides codebook-md.output.timestampTimezone.

codebook-md.bash.persistentSession.description: Run shell cells in one long-lived shell per notebook, so cd, export, variables and functions carry over from one cell to the next - like typing into a terminal. A failing command doesn't stop the rest of the cell. Override it for a single cell from the cell's configuration (the gear below the cell).

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Dynamic Folder Group in the My Notebooks webview

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.name.description: Display name for the Dynamic Folder Group

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.descripti.default: Auto-generated based on the current file
codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.descripti.description: Description shown when hovering over the Dynamic Folder Group

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.subFolder.description: Sub-folders to include when searching for markdown files. A plain name (e.g. '.github') is matched at every level. An entry with a slash or a wildcard is a pattern relative to each folder in the group (e.g. 'tooling/**' for 'tooling' and everything below it).

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.exclusion.description: List of patterns to exclude from the Dynamic Folder Group

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.includeAg.description: Find agent docs in their standard locations and show them in the Dynamic Folder Group without listing their folders in subFolderInclusions: skills (SKILL.md), instruction files, scoped rules, prompts and agent definitions.

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.placeRule.description: Show an agent rule that is scoped to a folder under that folder in the Dynamic Folder Group, instead of where the rule file is kept. The scope is read from the rule's front matter: applyTo, paths, globs or fileMatchPattern. For example, a rule with applyTo: "extractor/**" is listed under the extractor folder.

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.startColl.description: Start the Dynamic Folder Group collapsed in the My Notebooks view. Opening or closing it by hand is remembered until this setting changes.

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.icon.description: Icon shown beside the Dynamic Folder Group's name: a codicon name such as target, book or rocket. Leave empty for the default icon.

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.position.description: Where the Dynamic Folder Group sits among your own folder groups in the My Notebooks view: the number of your folder groups listed before it. 0 puts it first. Dragging the group in Side Bar Settings sets this.

enumDescriptions: Project policy files such as CONTRIBUTING.md
Agent instruction files such as AGENTS.md

codebook-md.dynamicFolderGroup.hiddenDoc.description: Kinds of document the Dynamic Folder Group leaves out. For example, add skill to show the group without skills.

codebook-md.aiDocs.enabled.description: Show the AI Docs view when the workspace has agent docs: instruction files such as AGENTS.md, skills, rules, prompts and agent definitions, grouped by type.

codebook-md.aiDocs.includeUserDocs.description: Also list your own agent docs in the AI Docs view: the instruction files, skills, rules, commands and agents kept in your home folder, such as ~/.claude/skills. They are read from disk only and shown in a group of their own.

codebook-md.aiDocs.exclusions.description: File and folder names the AI Docs view skips when it looks through the workspace. * is a wildcard.

codebook-md.aiDocs.hiddenDocTypes.description: Groups the AI Docs view leaves out. For example, add reference to hide Agent References.

codebook-md.output.showExecutableCodeInO.description: Show the executable code at the top of the output.

codebook-md.output.replaceOutputCell.description: Replace the output cell on each run. When false, output is appended.

codebook-md.output.showTimestamp.description: Show the timestamp at the top of the output.

codebook-md.output.timestampTimezone.description: Timezone to use for the timestamp (e.g. 'UTC', 'America/New_York').

codebook-md.executionHistory.enabled.description: Enable execution history tracking for code blocks

codebook-md.executionHistory.historyLimi.description: Maximum number of execution history entries to retain per cell (0 for unlimited)

codebook-md.codeLens.enabled.description: Show "Open as CodebookMD Notebook" and "Run in CodebookMD" links above code blocks when a markdown file is open in the text editor.

codebook-md.markdown.previewStyling.description: Style markdown cells like the Markdown Preview: bold headings with rules under the top two levels, tables with striped rows, preview-style blockquotes and code blocks with a copy button, and front matter shown as a table. VS Code shares one markdown renderer across notebook types, so this also affects markdown cells in other notebooks, such as Jupyter. Task list checkboxes are shown either way.
